settings.headline: Do the best work of your career,
settings.subtitle: Groundwork is a hand-picked board of remote and hybrid roles at companies decarbonizing energy, industry, food and cities. Every listing shows a real salary range.

settings.note: Counted live from the listings on this site every time the page renders.

settings.headline: Find your corner of climate
settings.body: Software, hardware, science and the people who sell it. Every category links to a filtered, shareable search.

items.title: Salary on every listing
items.body: No range, no listing. You see the band before you spend an evening on a cover letter.

items.title: Remote means remote
items.body: Each role says remote, hybrid or on-site, plus the time zones or cities it actually works from.

items.title: Feeds, not alerts
items.body: Subscribe to every role with RSS or JSON Feed, or bookmark any filtered search. No account needed.

settings.headline: Salary benchmarks, live from the board.
settings.body: Members see average bands by category, curated saved searches with live counts, and early notice of featured roles.
